description_id: Bundle skill + template Web Creator. Bikin website komplit (landing, multi-page, blog), deploy ke Vercel, sarankan domain Indonesia (Niagahoster, IDwebhost, Hostinger), dan extract data dari 6 situs Indonesia populer (Tokopedia, Shopee, Glints, Kompas, OLX, Lamudi) — Phase 4-3 seed skills, DRAFT scaffolding sampai founder graduate via Autobrowse.

skills.description_id: Bikin landing page satu halaman dari 5 template (SaaS, agency, course, portfolio, e-commerce). Customer kasih nama bisnis + value prop, output adalah preview URL siap deploy.
skills.description_en: Build a single-page landing site from 5 templates. Customer provides business name + value prop; output is a preview URL ready to deploy.

skills.description_id: Susun multi-page site (home, about, services, contact) dengan navigation dan typography konsisten. Cocok buat UMKM yang butuh presence online tanpa pakai jasa designer.
skills.description_en: Compose a multi-page site (home, about, services, contact) with consistent navigation and typography. Suited for SMBs that want an online presence without hiring a designer.

skills.description_id: Tulis blog post SEO-optimized buat search Indonesia. Riset keyword search-intent lokal, heading hierarchy, dan CTA yang jelas. Output siap publish.
skills.description_en: Write SEO-optimized blog posts for Indonesian search. Local-intent keyword research, heading hierarchy, clear CTA. Publish-ready output.

skills.description_id: Deploy site yang dibikin Web Creator ke Vercel. Setup custom domain hookup kalau customer udah punya. Output URL preview + production-ready.
skills.description_en: Deploys Web Creator output to Vercel. Hooks up a custom domain if the customer has one. Returns preview + production URLs.

skills.description_id: Bandingkan harga + fitur Niagahoster, IDwebhost, dan Hostinger. Rekomendasi tergantung kebutuhan customer (bisnis kecil, e-commerce, multi-domain). Customer beli sendiri di provider pilihan.
skills.description_en: Compare price + features across Niagahoster, IDwebhost, Hostinger. Recommendation depends on customer's need profile (small biz, e-commerce, multi-domain). Customer purchases directly with chosen provider.

skills.description_id: Playbook 6 langkah yang membawa satu website dari brief sampai live — intake, build, checkpoint review preview lokal, deploy ke preview, checkpoint approve URL preview, lalu promote ke production. Dua titik henti supaya customer cek hasil sebelum lanjut.
skills.description_en: Six-step playbook that takes a website from brief to live — intake, build, local-preview review checkpoint, preview deploy, preview-URL approval checkpoint, then production promote. Two checkpoints so the customer reviews before each next stage.

templates.description_id: Template SaaS landing — hero + features + pricing + CTA. Indonesian-localized example copy untuk SaaS B2B.
Template agency landing — services + portfolio + team + contact. Cocok buat consulting / digital agency.
Template course landing — outcome-led hero + curriculum + instructor + pricing. Buat kursus online.
Template portfolio — work samples + about + contact. Cocok buat freelancer atau independent professional.
Template e-commerce — featured products + shop + about. Pre-Stripe/Xendit hookup; checkout customer setup sendiri.
Multi-page bundle untuk UMKM — home + about + services + contact + WhatsApp CTA. 4 halaman terkoneksi.
Long-form blog template (1500-2500 kata) — heading hierarchy, intro hook, body sections, FAQ, CTA penutup.
Listicle blog template (5/7/10 items) — intro context, item structure dengan example + actionable takeaway, summary.
How-to / tutorial blog — outcome statement + prerequisites + step-by-step + troubleshooting + summary.
Snapshot harga + fitur Niagahoster, IDwebhost, Hostinger (2026-Q2). Updated quarterly. Includes per-TLD price + customer-support summary + uptime data.
